siteChecks.label: XML sitemap
siteChecks.fix: Publish /sitemap.xml and reference it in robots.txt and Search Console / Bing Webmaster.

siteChecks.label: HTTP permanently redirects to HTTPS
siteChecks.fix: Use a 301 redirect from http:// to https://.

siteChecks.label: Missing pages return 404
siteChecks.fix: Return a real 404 status for unknown URLs (soft 404s waste crawl budget).

siteChecks.label: AI bots not blocked by firewall/CDN
llms.txt published
siteChecks.fix: Publish /llms.txt — a markdown summary of who you are and links to your key pages for LLMs.

siteChecks.label: Site has FAQ / Q&A content
siteChecks.fix: Build FAQ sections for core services (home health, hospice, billing, OASIS…) with FAQPage schema.

siteChecks.label: Homepage Organization schema
siteChecks.fix: Add Organization JSON-LD with name, logo, url, sameAs (LinkedIn, G2, Capterra…) on the homepage.

issues.label: XML sitemap
issues.fix: Publish /sitemap.xml and reference it in robots.txt and Search Console / Bing Webmaster.

issues.label: HTTP permanently redirects to HTTPS
issues.fix: Use a 301 redirect from http:// to https://.

issues.label: Site has FAQ / Q&A content
issues.fix: Build FAQ sections for core services (home health, hospice, billing, OASIS…) with FAQPage schema.

issues.label: Homepage Organization schema
issues.fix: Add Organization JSON-LD with name, logo, url, sameAs (LinkedIn, G2, Capterra…) on the homepage.

issues.label: Missing pages return 404
issues.fix: Return a real 404 status for unknown URLs (soft 404s waste crawl budget).

issues.label: Question-style headings
issues.fix: Phrase some H2/H3s as the questions buyers ask ("What is home health software?").

issues.label: Concise answers under questions (15–70 words)
issues.detail: 0/0 questions followed by a snippet-length answer
issues.fix: Answer each question directly in the first 40–60 words below the heading, then elaborate.

issues.label: Content in raw HTML (no JS needed)
issues.detail: 8 words in server HTML · text/HTML ratio 0.4%
issues.fix: Most AI crawlers do not run JavaScript — server-render or pre-render the main content.

issues.label: Meta description 70–160 chars
issues.fix: Add a compelling 70–160 character meta description summarizing the page.

issues.label: Exactly one H1
issues.fix: Use a single H1 that states the page topic.

issues.label: Canonical URL set
issues.fix: Add <link rel="canonical"> pointing to the preferred URL to avoid duplicate content.

issues.label: Substantive content (300+ words)
issues.fix: Expand thin pages with useful, specific content.

issues.label: Valid JSON-LD present
issues.fix: Add schema.org JSON-LD (Organization, WebPage, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage...).

issues.label: Entity schema (Organization/Product)
issues.fix: Describe Careficient as an Organization / SoftwareApplication in JSON-LD so LLMs resolve the entity.

issues.label: Specific facts & statistics
issues.fix: Generative engines favour concrete, quotable numbers — add stats, outcomes and data points.

issues.label: llms.txt published
issues.fix: Publish /llms.txt — a markdown summary of who you are and links to your key pages for LLMs.

issues.label: Title tag 30–60 chars
issues.fix: Write a unique, descriptive title of 30–60 characters with the primary keyword first.

issues.label: Uses H2 sub-sections
issues.fix: Break content into H2 sections so search engines (and AI) can map topics.

issues.label: Open Graph tags
issues.fix: Add Open Graph tags so shares (and some AI previews) render rich cards.

issues.label: Internal links
issues.fix: Link to related pages to distribute authority and help crawlers discover content.

issues.label: FAQ / HowTo / QA schema
issues.fix: Mark up FAQ content with FAQPage (or HowTo/QAPage) JSON-LD.

issues.label: Lists or tables for extraction
issues.fix: Use bulleted steps, comparisons and tables — answer engines lift these verbatim.

issues.label: Clear lead summary paragraph
issues.fix: Open with a 1–3 sentence summary of what the page offers and for whom.

issues.label: Cites external sources
issues.fix: Cite authoritative sources (CMS, regulations, studies) — cited content is cited back.

issues.label: Brand entity named in copy
issues.fix: Name the brand explicitly in body copy (not only in logos) so LLMs associate claims with it.

issues.label: BreadcrumbList schema
issues.fix: Add BreadcrumbList schema to clarify site hierarchy.

issues.label: Author / publisher signals
issues.fix: Attribute content to a named author or the organization (E-E-A-T trust signals).

issues.label: Freshness date signal
issues.fix: Expose dateModified in schema and keep key pages updated within 12 months.
